articles.title: Wayne Rooney reveals suicidal thoughts during Manchester United career
articles.summary: Former Manchester United star Wayne Rooney has revealed that he seriously considered taking his own life during his playing days at the club. He admitted to speaking with a therapist to help cope with his mental struggles and figure out what was wrong during a particularly difficult period in his career.

articles.title: Tony Mowbray steps down from Blackburn Rovers role
articles.summary: Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray has temporarily stepped back from his managerial responsibilities at the Championship club. The decision comes as the 62-year-old manager deals with ongoing health issues that require him to take a leave of absence from the team for the second time.

articles.title: Izzy Goodwin earns maiden England call-up for qualifiers
articles.summary: London City Lionesses forward Izzy Goodwin has received her very first senior call-up to the England women's national team. She has been named in the squad by head coach Sarina Wiegman for the upcoming crucial World Cup qualifying play-off matches against Ukraine.

articles.title: Arsenal in advanced discussions over Piero Hincapie contract
articles.summary: Premier League side Arsenal are reportedly locked in advanced negotiations with defender Piero Hincapie regarding a brand new contract. The club is looking to secure the player's long-term future following his impressive performances and growing importance within the squad under Mikel Arteta.

articles.title: Tony Mowbray leaves Blackburn role due to health concerns
articles.summary: Tony Mowbray has officially stepped down as Blackburn Rovers head coach due to ongoing health problems. Having returned to the club in June to guide them up to 13th in the Championship table, the 62-year-old manager is once again forced to prioritize his well-being and leave his position.

articles.title: Declan Rice agrees lucrative new five-year Arsenal deal
articles.summary: England midfielder Declan Rice has agreed a new five-year contract with Arsenal that will run until 2031. The lucrative extension will make him one of the club's joint highest-paid players, matching Bukayo Saka's weekly wages following his stellar performances since joining from West Ham.

articles.title: Blackburn boss Tony Mowbray steps down for health reasons
articles.summary: Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray has stepped down from his position due to continuing health issues. The experienced manager had successfully steered the team into 13th place in the Championship before needing to step away from his duties once again.

articles.title: Jacob Bethell ruled out of South Africa tour with knee injury
articles.summary: England batter Jacob Bethell will miss the upcoming tour of South Africa after it was confirmed he requires further surgery. The young batsman is sidelined as he undergoes another medical procedure to address a persistent knee issue that has hampered his availability.
